All 3 fields accepted the spaces DURING typing (innerText: 'PKW · 60 Min. x y z', 'Lange Lektion für konzentrierte Übungen a b c', 'HIGHLIGHT… K M N' – highlight uppercased by CSS text-transform but SPACES ARE THERE). After blur→PATCH round-trip AND full page reload, all three values persisted. (2) P0-FIX 2 (homepage insurance): data-testid='pricing-insurance-box' present at bottom of /#pricing, class contains 'border-2 border-[#ff5a36]', ShieldCheck SVG icon present, label 'WICHTIGER HINWEIS', text 'Für Neukund:innen fällt eine einmalige Versicherungspauschale von CHF 120 an (zahlbar bei der zweiten Lektion)…'. (3) P0-FIX 2 (location pages – IMPORTANT NOTE): /fahrschule-waedenswil, /fahrschule-siebnen, /fahrschule-einsiedeln DO show the insurance box, but under testid 'pricing-insurance-box' (not 'loc-price-insurance-box' as the review request specified). This is because LocationPage.jsx uses the shared <Pricing lockedCanton=..> component, not LocPrices.jsx. LocPrices.jsx (where main agent added the 'loc-price-insurance-box' testid) is DEAD CODE – no page imports it. Visually the box is displayed on all location pages so user-facing requirement is met; only the testid is different. (4) P0-FIX 3 (blog CRUD): full flow works – login → /admin?tab=blog → admin-blog-add-toggle opens admin-blog-add-form → filled title → admin-blog-add-submit → POST /api/blog returned 200 with slug, form closed, new row appeared at top, GET /blog/<slug> loads with correct title, deletion via trash icon removed the row (confirm dialog auto-accepted). All test data cleaned up (pkw-45/pkw-60 restored to original values via API).

integration_issues.issue: Review request expects data-testid='loc-price-insurance-box' on /fahrschule-* pages, but that testid comes from LocPrices.jsx which is imported nowhere. LocationPage.jsx line 206 uses <Pricing data={content?.pricing} lockedCanton={loc.canton} /> which renders data-testid='pricing-insurance-box'. Functionally the box IS shown, but the testid does not match the spec. Impact: any downstream code/tests that specifically query 'loc-price-insurance-box' on location pages will find nothing.

Currently the insurance box IS visible on location pages via the shared Pricing component, so no user-facing regression, but the review-request-specified testid ('loc-price-insurance-box') is unreachable.

LocPrices.jsx is DEAD CODE – no page imports it (grep of /app/frontend/src returns only the file's own export). Either delete it or wire it into LocationPage.jsx. Right now edits to it are invisible to end users.

rca of the issue: All 3 P0 bugs reported by user are RESOLVED. RCA of spacebar bug: EditablePackageCard had an outer div with onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key===' ') { e.preventDefault(); onSelect(...) } }}. Because onKeyDown bubbles up from nested contentEditable spans, typing Space inside the title/subtitle/feature/highlight fired the outer preventDefault, eating the space. Fix: added early return `if (e.target !== e.currentTarget) return;` so only Space typed directly on the card container triggers selection. RCA of insurance-box UX: previous rendering was a small inline paragraph mt-10 text-sm – too easy to miss; user requested a bigger, more visible info box with icon. Fix: replaced with a bordered rounded-2xl block containing ShieldCheck icon + big 'WICHTIGER HINWEIS' label + editable note. RCA of blog creation friction: previously admins could only edit existing posts – no way to create from the dashboard. Fix: added inline form to BlogManager with a right-slot 'Neuer Beitrag' toggle that POSTs to /api/blog then redirects the admin to edit inline on the website.
